gold_standard_source.title: Candidate List — Registrar of Voters, Alameda County (Election: 'General Election - 11/03/2026 (Official)')
gold_standard_source.retrieval_method: POST to https://alamedacountyca.gov/rov_app/candidatelist/ with electionId=260, categoryId=270 (Special Districts), raceId per race; each race panel prints an explicit Race Status label ('On Ballot' or 'Not On Ballot') plus the complete filing roster and a filings count

findings.note: Registrar's official Candidate List for the General Election 11/03/2026 (Official) labels race 'AC Transit District Director, Ward 7' with Race Status = Not On Ballot. Sole filing: DIANE SHAW (Filing Completed, Incumbent: N, Declaration of Candidacy filed 07/27/2026; '1 Filing'). The status label is an explicit official determination printed on the certified list — not an inference from absence. Corroborated by the county Voter Information Guide for Nov 3 2026, whose candidate-statement section includes only AC Transit Ward 3, Ward 4 and Ward 5 director races (no Ward 7). Consistent with Elections Code 10515 appointment-in-lieu for a sole candidate; no separate cancellation resolution was located.

exhaustiveness_argument: The Registrar's Candidate List page is the county's official certified candidate list for 'General Election - 11/03/2026 (Official)' and prints an explicit per-race Race Status ('On Ballot' / 'Not On Ballot') for every contest in the Special Districts category, including both on-ballot and off-ballot races side by side (e.g., BART District 4 = On Ballot vs BART District 6 = Not On Ballot within the same list). The determination therefore rests on an affirmative official label retrieved per race, not on absence-from-list inference. The county VIG sample-ballot/candidate-statement content independently omits exactly these six races and includes the sibling contested races.
limitations: The registrar's candidate list is a dynamic POST-driven page (alamedacountyca.gov/rov_app/candidatelist); results cannot be cited by a stable per-race deep link. Reproduction: POST electionId=260&categoryId=270&raceId=<61|65|69|71|72|82>&lastName=&raceStatus=&candidateStatus=. Raw HTML snapshots were retained at /tmp/alco/race_*.html.

No individual cancellation or appointment resolution (board minute / EC 10515 appointment order) was independently retrieved for any of the six races; determinations rest on the Registrar's certified 'Not On Ballot' status label, which is sufficient under project policy as official final-ballot material. Do not describe these as agency-confirmed cancellations.

dsrsd.com live pages returned HTTP 403 to curl; the DSRSD elections page was read from a Wayback snapshot (2026-05-18), which predates candidate filing and is used only as context for the EC 10515 appointment mechanism, not as ballot evidence.

bart.gov and actransit.org pages retrieved are pre-certification scheduled-election/candidate-info notices; they do not establish or refute November placement and were treated as non-authoritative for this determination.

The VIG PDF was fetched from acvote.alamedacountyca.gov (the same href published on the county Election Information page); the alamedacountyca.gov host returned 404 for the asset path. SHA-256 of the retrieved PDF: 5b1e32e3b8faab472f2923ea17685035b4e8595e18ddf1f37c9fcd90a88fa0e3.
Party is not shown for any of these races (all nonpartisan special-district contests); the list's BALLOT DESIGNATION column shows occupations, recorded in quotes above rather than as party.
